name: handelsregister.ai
summary: German company data from the Handelsregister, Bundesanzeiger and insolvency notices as JSON: company search, full profiles with directors, shareholders, UBOs and financials, person profiles, and a feed of register changes.

api_key.description: A handelsregister.ai API key (dashboard after sign-up). Sent in the x-api-key header.

notes: Billed in credits (1 credit = EUR 0.01 list price). Failed calls cost nothing, except the +20 AI surcharge once an AI lookup ran; meta.request_credit_cost in each answer gives the real charge and meta.credits_remaining the balance. 402 means the balance is below the call's maximum cost.
Rate limits per account per minute, all keys together, rejected calls included: fetch-organization 60, fetch-person 60, search and Signals share 60. 429 carries Retry-After.
Profile and person calls can take up to 120 seconds (then a free 408), longer than call_vendor's fixed 60-second timeout; retry a timed-out call.
Until the account's email is verified, every call answers 403. Monitoring, webhooks, token and key management are writes and are not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Search German companies
endpoints.summary: Companies by name and/or filters (location, legal form, WZ industry code, status, register, size, financial ranges), with entity_id, register, address and status.

q.description: Company name words, 2-500 characters; omit rather than send empty.

filters.description: A JSON object of filters, e.g. {"city": "Ansbach", "legal_form_code": "GmbH", "active": true} or {"financial_filters": {"pl_revenue": {"gte": 1000000}}}; field names and values are case-sensitive (schema OrganizationSearchFilters).

sort.description: relevance, distance (needs the geo filters), registration_date, revenue, profit, employees, total_assets, equity, liabilities, cash, equity_ratio, financial_year, share_capital, last_activity, largest_share_ratio, management_size, md_oldest_birth_date or md_youngest_birth_date.

match_context.description: 1 to explain per hit why it matched.

Idempotency_Key.description: Optional key (1-128 chars of A-Za-z0-9._:-, starting alphanumeric): a repeat with the same key and parameters within 24 h is returned again for 0 credits.

notes: 1 credit per page, an empty page included. Give q or filters; neither is a 400 (free).
Only the first 10,000 hits are reachable and there is no cursor: split large queries by state, postal code or date. total is an estimate; read it with total_relation.
The owner, ownership, executive and lifecycle filter groups need the Pro or Max plan (403 otherwise, free). An unknown filter key is a 422 (free); an unknown value returns no hits and is charged.

endpoints.name: Get a company profile
endpoints.summary: One company's profile (register, address, purpose, capital, status), plus the paid features asked for: directors, shareholders, UBOs, holdings, financial KPIs and statements, publications, insolvencies, news, M&A.

q.description: The entity_id from search (most reliable), court plus register type and number (Ansbach HRB 6089), or a name with legal form and city.

features.description: Comma-separated paid features, each charged only when it returns data: financial_kpi (1 credit), publications (1), related_persons (2), balance_sheet_accounts (3), profit_and_loss_account (3), insolvency_publications (5), annual_financial_statements (5, Markdown), annual_financial_statements__html (5), shareholders (5), shareholdings (5), news (10), ubos (10), mergers_and_acquisitions (20), network (25, Pro and Max), shareholders_deep (80, Max).

financial_statement_type.description: Which statements the financial features use: auto (each picks), annual (single entity) or consolidated (group); a forced type never falls back.

financial_years.description: The N newest fiscal years for the financial features, 1-30.

realtime_mode.description: Re-fetch live register data: +10 credits, charged only on success; much slower.

ai_search.description: AI enrichment and fuzzy name resolution: +20 credits, charged once the lookup runs; purpose becomes an AI summary and a web-only profile may come back (entity_id AI_TMP_...).

Idempotency_Key.description: Optional key (1-128 chars of A-Za-z0-9._:-, starting alphanumeric): a repeat with the same key and parameters within 24 h is returned again for 0 credits.

notes: 5 credits base on success, plus each feature that returns data. A bare name can resolve to any of several matching companies; prefer the entity_id.
Financial expenses carry the sign printed in the filing; compare years only within one _provenance.statement_type.

endpoints.name: Get a person profile
endpoints.summary: A person's register roles and shareholdings across companies, merged with AI web evidence, found from one company they are linked to.

person_q.description: The person's name, at least 2 characters.

organization_q.description: A company where the person holds or held a register role, at least 2 characters.

features.description: Comma-separated: shareholdings (+5 credits when returned), network.

Idempotency_Key.description: Optional key (1-128 chars of A-Za-z0-9._:-, starting alphanumeric): a repeat with the same key and parameters within 24 h is returned again for 0 credits.

notes: 15 credits on success; needs an active Plus, Pro or Max subscription (403 otherwise). 404, free, when no person links confidently to that company. Often takes 10-30 seconds.

endpoints.name: List register change signals
endpoints.summary: Normalized commercial-register changes across companies, newest announcement first: new registrations, master data changes, closures, management changes, capital changes, insolvencies, transformations.

topics.description: Comma-separated topic codes: NEW_REGISTRATIONS, MASTER_DATA_CHANGES, CLOSURES, ROLE_HOLDER_CHANGES, CAPITAL_CHANGES (any plan), INSOLVENCIES (Pro, Max), TRANSFORMATIONS (Max). Omitted, only the topics your plan allows.

from.description: Earliest announcement date, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS without a time zone.

to.description: Latest announcement date, same format; a bare date covers the whole day.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page, sent back with exactly the same filters.

notes: 20 credits per page, empty pages included. Up to 20 per page; short or empty pages with has_more true are normal, so page until next_cursor is absent.
Any other parameter is a 422. Delivery is at least once: de-duplicate by event.id. Changing a filter mid-pagination can silently return a wrong page.

endpoints.name: Get one signal
endpoints.summary: One register change event by its id, with the organization, parties and source.
notes: 20 credits on success; takes no query parameters.

endpoints.name: List signal topics
endpoints.summary: The Signals topics with the plan tier each needs, and the paging options.
notes: Free. Any query parameter is a 422.

endpoints.name: Get credit balance
endpoints.summary: Credit balance split into subscription and purchased credits, with the next expiring grant.

endpoints.name: Get usage
endpoints.summary: Credits used over a date range, by endpoint and by day or month.

from.description: Start date; default the start of the current month.

to.description: End date; at most 366 days after from.
